title: console(marketplace): on an offline boot (OS_CLOUD_URL=off) Installed Apps → Details renders "App Marketplace is turned off" ahead of the install-local reseed / purge menu, so neither is reachable
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 · platform-core.marketplace-console-honesty · acceptance[2]

Clause A3 of `platform-core.marketplace-console-honesty` fails in the ObjectStack 17.7 pre-release checklist run objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 (framework subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`). An independent verifier (VF4, RUNNER rule 7; code at the pin) confirmed it: P3. It predates the 17.6.0 console pin `31971ff1e`; no open duplicate was found. Owner: objectui.

## Reproduction

1. Boot a scratch copy of the showcase with `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`. Install-local caches under `{cwd}/.objectstack`, so do not use a shared tree.
2. `os package install examples/app-crm/dist/objectstack.json -r http://localhost:{port}`.
3. Server truth: `/runtime/config` reports `marketplace:false`, and Installed Apps lists `com.example.crm` v4.0.0.
4. Browser, as admin: Setup → Installed Apps. The row offers Refresh / Details / Uninstall only. Click Details, which opens `/system/marketplace/com.example.crm`.
5. Expected: reseed / purge affordances that issue `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/com.example.crm/{reseed,purge}-sample-data`.
6. Actual: "App Marketplace is turned off", with 0 install-local wire calls. Seen twice.

**Note:** the purge endpoint itself fails separately (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21728). This card is only about the console reaching it.

## Mechanism

- `InstalledListWidget.tsx:155` links Details to `/system/marketplace/:packageId`.
- `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:568` returns the `MarketplaceDisabled` card when `!marketplaceEnabled`, before the local reseed/purge menu (`:752`).
- Offline (`features.marketplace=false`, `offlineInstallLocal` on), the two affordances therefore cannot be reached from the UI.
- The code is identical at `31971ff1e`.

## Done when

The local-package page (or Installed Apps) offers reseed / purge on a marketplace-disabled boot that permits install-local.
